title: Embedded Figures
parentNote: Ask him to point at each shape with his finger while counting out loud — it stops him from counting the same shape twice or missing one.
learnBullets: Spotting simple shapes **hidden inside** a bigger picture
Telling apart look-alikes — like a **square** (all sides equal) vs. a **rectangle** (sides unequal)
learnItFirst:
**The Big Idea:** Every picture — a house, a rocket, a butterfly — is really just simple shapes put together!

```
   ▲          ← Triangle (roof)
  ▲▲▲
 ■■■■■        ← Square (body)
 ■■■■■
```
This house picture is made of **1 triangle + 1 square**.

**Watch out for tricky look-alikes:**
| Shape | Rule |
|---|---|
| Square | All 4 sides are EQUAL |
| Rectangle | Opposite sides equal, but longer/shorter |

### 🧠 How to Solve — 3 Easy Steps
1. **Point** at each part of the picture one at a time.
2. **Name** its shape (triangle, square, circle, rectangle...).
3. **Count** — keep a running tally so you don't count the same shape twice.

---

sections.name: Warm Up
sections.leadingContext:
A house is made of a triangle (roof) sitting on top of a square (body):
```
   ▲
  ▲▲▲
 ■■■■■
 ■■■■■
```

questions.content: What shape is the ROOF of the house?
questions.why: The pointed top part of the house is a triangle

questions.content: What shape is the BODY of the house?
questions.trailingContext:
An ice-cream 🍦 is made of a circle (scoop) sitting on a triangle (cone):
```
  ⬤
  ▽
```
questions.why: The main block of the house is a square

questions.content: What shape is the SCOOP (top part)?
questions.why: The round scoop on top is a circle

questions.content: What shape is the CONE (bottom part)?
questions.why: The pointed bottom part is a triangle

questions.content: A kite 🪁 has a diamond shape in the middle. How many corners does a diamond have?
questions.trailingContext:
A traffic light 🚦 is a rectangle with 3 circles inside it, stacked one on top of another:
```
■■■
 ●
 ●
 ●
■■■
```
questions.why: A diamond is a 4-sided shape, so it has 4 corners

questions.content: How many circles are inside the traffic light picture?
questions.why: There are 3 circles stacked inside the traffic light

questions.content: A snowman ⛄ is made of 3 circles stacked (small, medium, big). How many circles make up the snowman?
questions.why: The snowman is built from 3 stacked circles

questions.content: A robot 🤖 face is made of 1 square (head), 1 rectangle (body), and 2 small circles (eyes). How many shapes make up the robot in total?
questions.why: 1 square head + 1 rectangle body + 2 circle eyes = 4 shapes

questions.content: A boat 🛶 has a triangle sail on top of a rectangle hull. What shape is the SAIL?
questions.why: The sail is pointed like a triangle

questions.content: A rocket 🚀 is made of 1 triangle (nose), 1 rectangle (body), and 2 small triangles (side fins). How many triangles are in the rocket picture in total?
questions.why: 1 nose triangle + 2 fin triangles = 3 triangles

questions.content: A fish 🐟 is made of 1 big triangle (body) + 1 small triangle (tail) + 1 circle (eye). How many triangles are in the fish?
questions.why: 1 big triangle (body) + 1 small triangle (tail) = 2

questions.content: Using the same fish, how many circles are in the picture?
questions.why: Only the eye is a circle

questions.content: A tree 🌳 is made of 1 triangle (leaves) + 1 rectangle (trunk). How many straight-sided shapes are used in total?
questions.why: The triangle (leaves) and the rectangle (trunk) are both straight-sided

questions.content: A 6-pointed star can be drawn using 2 overlapping triangles — one pointing up, one pointing down. How many triangles make this star?
questions.why: One triangle points up, the other points down — 2 triangles total

questions.content: A robot face is made of 1 square (face) + 2 circles (eyes) + 1 rectangle (mouth). How many shapes make up the face in total?
questions.why: 1 square + 2 circles + 1 rectangle = 4 shapes

questions.content: A house picture has 1 triangular roof, 1 square body, 1 rectangular door, and 2 square windows. How many SQUARES are in the picture (including the body)?
questions.why: 1 square body + 2 square windows = 3 squares

questions.content: Using the same house, how many RECTANGLES are in the picture?
questions.why: Only the door is a rectangle (unequal sides)

questions.content: Using the same house, how many TRIANGLES are in the picture?
questions.why: Only the roof is a triangle

questions.content: Using the same house (roof + body + door + 2 windows), how many shapes make up the WHOLE picture?
questions.why: 1 roof + 1 body + 1 door + 2 windows = 5 shapes

questions.content: A butterfly 🦋 is made of 2 big triangles (wings) + 1 small rectangle (body). How many triangles are there?
questions.why: The two wings are both triangles

questions.content: Using the same butterfly, how many shapes are there in total?
questions.why: 2 triangle wings + 1 rectangle body = 3 shapes

questions.content: An ice-cream has 3 scoops (3 circles stacked) on 1 triangle cone. How many circles are there?
questions.why: There are 3 stacked scoop circles

questions.content: Using the same ice-cream, how many shapes are there in total (3 circles + 1 triangle)?
questions.why: 3 circles + 1 triangle cone = 4 shapes

questions.content: A caterpillar is made of 5 circles joined in a row, plus 2 tiny circles for antenna tips. How many circles are there in total?
questions.why: 5 body circles + 2 antenna tip circles = 7

questions.content: A flower 🌸 is made of 5 small circles (petals) around 1 bigger circle (centre), plus 1 rectangle (stem). How many circles are in the flower?
questions.why: 5 petal circles + 1 centre circle = 6

questions.content: A picture shows 2 triangles, 3 four-sided shapes, and 1 circle — but ONE of the "four-sided shapes" is actually a rectangle (not a true square, since its sides are unequal). How many TRUE squares are there?
questions.why: Out of 3 four-sided shapes, 1 is really a rectangle, leaving 2 true squares

questions.content: A rocket has 1 triangle (nose cone), 1 rectangle (body), 2 small triangles (fins), and 1 circle (window). If we remove the nose cone, how many triangles remain?
questions.why: 2 side fins remain after removing the 1 nose cone triangle

questions.content: A face is made of 1 big circle (outline), 2 small circles (eyes), 1 triangle (nose), and 1 curved smile line (which is NOT a closed shape). How many CLOSED shapes are in the face?
questions.why: 1 big circle + 2 small circles + 1 triangle are closed shapes; the smile line is open, so it doesn't count

questions.content: A picture is drawn using 3 separate circles, even though some of them overlap each other. How many circles were used to draw the picture?
questions.why: Even though they overlap, 3 separate circles were drawn

questions.content: A toy train has 1 engine + 2 coaches (3 rectangles in total), and each rectangle has 2 circle wheels underneath (6 circles in total). How many shapes make up the WHOLE train (rectangles + circles)?
questions.why: 3 rectangles + 6 wheel circles = 9 shapes
